requirements.item_text: Arrangements are in place so that, as far as possible, storage, distribution and later handling maintain product quality throughout shelf life.

mappings.quote: Satisfactory arrangements exist to ensure, as far as possible, that the medicinal products are stored, distributed and subsequently handled so that quality is maintained throughout their shelf life

requirements.item_text: The distribution quality system ensures that GSP and GDP are adopted and implemented so product quality is maintained through the supply chain for the whole shelf life, and products are properly procured, stored, distributed and delivered to the right recipients.

mappings.quote: GSP and GDP are adopted and implemented to ensure that the quality of pharmaceutical products is maintained throughout their shelf life in the supply chain; and pharmaceutical products are appropriately procured, stored, distributed and delivered to the appropriate recipients
